MARY ANNE ROZNIK (nee NETSKAR) Peacefully on June 7, 2005, at the age of 81, in her home, Mary joined our Heavenly Father with her predeceased son William in 1998 and husband Joseph Roznik in 1994. Mary is survived by her children, Gordon (Jean), Chris (Ron), Irene (Brian), Barbara (Warren), Russ (Jani) and numerous grandchildren; sisters, Kay Portree and Frances (Maurice) Scuba and brother Stan Netskar. Mary grew up in Selkirk and moved to Winnipeg to attend college. She worked for CN Railways - Transcona for many years before leaving to raise her family on the farm in Springfield. Once the children were in school, she returned to work at the Freshwater Marketing Corp. where she retired from at the age of 66 years. Mary's stamina and strength enabled her to enjoy her family and outdoor activities such as cross-country skiing, cycling and long hikes. She frequently did this while visiting Birds Hill Park. She always kept busy whether it was in her garden or by reading. Mary enjoyed going to St. Michael's Church in Cooks Creek where she sang in the choir for many years. Mary loved life. Prayers will be said on Friday, June 10 at 7:00 p.m. at Cropo Funeral Chapel, 1442 Main St. Mass of Christian Burial will be celebrated on Saturday, June 11 at 1:00 p.m. at St. Michael's Roman Catholic Church, Cooks Creek, MB. Interment to follow in the Parish Cemetery. Pallbearers will be Gordon Roznik, Russell Roznik, Bryce Roznik, Brian Rychlicki, Warren Flannery, and Ron Jantzen. CROPO FUNERAL CHAPEL 586-8044

As published in Winnipeg Free Press on Jun 10, 2005
